description: Observed LocalMaxxing result. It is evidence for compatibility, not an executable launch contract.

localmaxxing.notes: Single-stream decode, batch 1, one concurrent request. n=9 generations (3 prompt kinds x 3 repeats), 512 output tokens each, streaming, temperature 0.60 top_p 0.95 top_k 20. Served context length 131072 (this is the CONFIGURED window, not the prompt depth; prompts here are short). mem-fraction-static 0.80, kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3, attention backend flashinfer, tp 1, max-running-requests 32. Idle box, one model loaded at a time, all six cells of the battery ran back to back in one session on one machine. Speculative decoding ON: DFlash, draft z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 rev 50307d4c4cde6860d4eee73e2547cd786fe8e8a4, 8 draft tokens per step, 1 step, eagle_topk 1. Per-workload decode: code 45.39, reasoning 48.28, prose 25.48 tok/s; the headline figure is the mean of all 9. Quantization detail: NVFP4 body with an unquantised BF16 lm_head. Served from HF revision 009632fef96dd349150baa780c984e62e70e91fe. Measured with a 3-prompt-kind by 3-repeat battery; per-run rows, the resolved server args and the launch script are retained locally as speed-rarkbf16-on.json, serverinfo-rarkbf16-on.json and battery.log. Happy to share the raw rows on request.
